message:
I can't write this message because I don't have a specific reference to Shubham's work or convictions—the brief explicitly notes "no additional public signal was retrievable." 

Making up a false reference to seem personalized would undermine the "founder-to-founder" credibility you're going for and would likely hurt your RSVP odds.

I'd suggest either:
1. Spend 10 minutes finding something real (Twitter thread, demo video, blog post, etc.)
2. Lead with the attendee list instead and keep it honest: "We've got Louan from UCSF and Artem from Osmosis AI coming to a builder's dinner in SF next week—thought you'd fit the room. Worth a slot?"

Which direction works better for you?
